_meta.purpose: Calibrate RETRIEVAL_MIN_SCORE and act as a retrieval regression test.
_meta.method: Questions were authored from real published article titles on abhrademo4, deliberately paraphrased into user language rather than copying title wording.
_meta.knownLimitation: Author-written questions are biased toward article vocabulary and will overstate retrieval quality versus real users. Augment with real phrasing sampled from incident.short_description (36,023 incidents available on this instance) before trusting absolute pass rates. Relative changes between runs remain meaningful.
_meta.citationKey: sysId. Article numbers are NOT unique on this instance (KB0010004 maps to four different articles), so sys_id is the only safe identifier.
